newsitem.title: USA: Forcenergy to merge with Edisto and Convest.
newsitem.headline: Forcenergy to merge with Edisto and Convest.

text.p: Forcenergy Inc said Friday it has entered into a definitive merger agreement with both Edisto Resources Corp and Convest Energy Corp in a $172.1 million cash and stock transaction.

The merger calls for each share of Edisto common stock to be converted into the right to receive $4.886 in cash and $5.064 of Forcenergy stock for a total consideration of $9.95 per share, Forcenergy said.
Each share of Convest stock will be converted into the right to receive $8.88 of Forcenergy stock, it said.
The exchange ratio will be determined by the average weighted daily trading price of Forcenergy stock for the 10 trading days before the two trading days prior to the merger closing, it said.
The conversion price will be between $28.96 and $34.96, Forcenergy said. The number of Forcenergy shares issued at closing will be between 2.79 million and 3.38 million.
Edisto currently owns about 72 percent of Convest's shares, the company said.
Edisto's primary assets are its majority stake in Convest and $68 million in cash, Forcenergy said.
Convest's assets include interests in 43 producing Gulf of Mexico lease blocks and on-shore reserves located in fields in which Forcenergy holds non-operated working interests, Forcenergy said.
Forcenergy estimates proven reserves associated with the merger total about 6.344 million barrels of oil and condensate and about 45.9 billion cubic feet of natural gas.
When complete, the merger will give Forcenergy an asset base of $900 million.
